user-data.content_utf8:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
exec >/dev/ttyu0 2>&1
printf 'CORPUS-BSD-START\n'
freebsd-version -k
kldload dtraceall || kldstat
printf '%s' 'I3ByYWdtYSBEIG9wdGlvbiBxdWlldAoKZHRyYWNlOjo6QkVHSU4KewogICAgcHJpbnRmKCJIZWxsbywgV29ybGQhXG4iKTsKICAgIGV4aXQoMCk7Cn0K' | /usr/bin/b64decode -r > /tmp/greeting.d
sha256 -q /tmp/greeting.d
/usr/sbin/dtrace -qs /tmp/greeting.d
printf 'CORPUS-BSD-DTRACE-OK\n'
/sbin/poweroff

reproduction_command: boot the recorded FreeBSD guest and execute dtrace -qs /tmp/greeting.d via the seed
semantic_scope: The guest hash matched the untouched DTrace program. The native FreeBSD kernel and DTrace command executed its BEGIN clause and emitted the exact greeting before shutdown.
path_normalization: Temporary paths use stable placeholders. Source hashes refer to the repository files listed in artifact_sha256.
